McCrindle’s annotated translation of the chapters on India in Ptolemy’s Geography, with the ancient names of its peoples, cities, rivers and ports identified (Calcutta, 1885). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

Item: Ancient India: as described by Ptolemy; being a translation of the chapters which describe India and Central and Eastern Asia in the treatise on geography written by Klaudios Ptolemaios, the celebrated astronomer · McCrindle, J.W. · 1885, 388 scanned pages. Published 1885; John Watson McCrindle died 1913; Ptolemy lived in the second century; public domain in India.
